sub: Four characters. One mission. Conquer 4,000 levels and claim rewards on-chain.
choose_desc: Enter the game, pick your playstyle, and fight for a spot at the top of the on-chain leaderboard.
rex_bio: Crowned ruler of the board. Rex plays with iron discipline — every move is calculated, every block placed for maximum domination. Fear the crown.
tide_bio: Cool as deep water. Tide reads the board like ocean currents — fluid, adaptive, unstoppable. Block by block, the tide always rises.
brawler_bio: No mercy, no retreat. Brawler charges every Act head-on, smashing through obstacles with raw aggression. The board will break before he does.
sunny_bio: Pure joy, pure chaos. Sunny turns even the hardest levels into a party — always smiling, always surprising, always stealing the win.
